mechanism: Senna-induced diarrhea and fluid loss potentiates bumetanide's diuretic and electrolyte-depleting effects, increasing risk of hypokalemia, hyponatremia, and dehydration.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium) and renal function regularly; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing agent; use senna only when necessary and for short durations.
